title: Predictive Test Optimization Without Historical Failure Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.18574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As software systems grow in size and complexity, their test suites become increasingly expensive to execute, delaying feedback and wasting resources. State-of-the-art predictive test optimization methods use machine learning to select tests relevant to a change, typically trained on historical failures. This depends on failure histories and is susceptible to label noise from flaky tests. We introduce the novel method of co-evolution labeling for predictive test optimization, deriving test relevance from tests and code changing together in the version history. These data are widely available and less noisy. We train and evaluate models with failure and co-evolution labels on three large projects---from industry and open source; each with thousands of tests and more than 1M LOC. translated_title: 无需历史失败数据的预测性测试优化
translated_abstract: 随着软件系统在规模和复杂性上的增长，其测试套件的执行成本变得越来越高，导致反馈延迟和资源浪费。最先进的预测性测试优化方法使用机器学习来选择与变更相关的测试，这些方法通常基于历史失败数据进行训练。然而，这依赖于失败历史，并且容易受到来自不稳定测试的标签噪声影响。我们引入了一种新颖的协同演化标注方法用于预测性测试优化，通过版本历史中测试与代码共同变化的情况来推导测试相关性。这些数据广泛可得且噪声更少。我们在三个大型项目上训练并评估了分别使用失败标签和协同演化标签的模型——项目涵盖工业界和开源领域，每个项目均包含数千个测试用例和超过一百万行代码。协同演化标注几乎达到了基于失败标签模型的故障检测能力，其总体平均故障检测百分比为0.88。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的协同演化标注方法，利用版本历史中测试与代码共同变化的信息来训练预测性测试优化模型，无需依赖历史失败数据，其故障检测能力几乎可与基于失败数据的模型相媲美。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel co-evolution labeling method for predictive test optimization that derives test relevance from tests and code changing together in version history, nearly matching the failure detection capabilities of failure-based models without requiring historical failure data.
